current_runtime_profile.name: current
current_runtime_profile.identity_authority: The current source manifest supplies source/ELF hashes, function inventory and complete ordered compilation units; actual execution requires its matching cold-build receipt.

bounded_types.0: IEEE binary32 Tensor: documented arithmetic, AD and conversion paths
bounded_types.1: Bool Tensor with one-byte elements: documented typed/logical/reduction paths
bounded_types.2: signed int64 Tensor with eight-byte elements: documented typed/integer/mixed/reduction paths
bounded_types.3: internal rank-zero wrapped IEEE binary64 Scalar only; no general F64 Tensor service
bounded_types.4: public dense no-grad binary64 candidate paths; original F64 48 and 192 logical comparisons are mandatory in the pending 1127 gate; requires_grad creation and as_strided remain separately recorded native refusal boundaries
bounded_types.5: public F16 storage/copy/fill and F32 conversion candidate paths; original Half47 and independent refusal12 are mandatory; no general Half arithmetic, AD, any/all or explicit Bool sum is inferred
bounded_types.6: public BF16 storage/copy/fill and F32 conversion candidate paths; original Half47 and independent refusal12 are mandatory; no general Half arithmetic, AD, any/all or explicit Bool sum is inferred

resource_bounds.storage: Documented nonnegative strides, offsets and empty layouts; distinct allocation, work and pool limits still apply.
resource_bounds.scope: These finite implementation caps are not PyTorch limits and are not all simultaneously attainable.

115.scope: Only admitted source/result combinations; Bool/I64-to-F32 converts each element before F32 reduction. Empty axis tuple reduces all dimensions. Floating requires_grad plus Bool output is refused after axis validation.

new_command_contracts.common: Rank0..4 and <=262144 logical elements; signed axes, keepdim0/1, zero reserved words, complete bounded axis payload. Scalar axis0/-1 is accepted. No out= or unimplemented dtype/backend contract is inferred.

current_image_qualification.success_rule: All eighteen groups must actually run and pass. Production cases bind the same current main source, ELF and cold-build receipt; Generator131 additionally links and executes separately identified current-object ABI and reordered probe images. Every original control, denominator, process exit/EOF and unchanged input binding remains mandatory. The twelve independent Half unsupported-protocol controls are not Torch compatibility comparisons.

observed_executions.scope: previous published image, actual complete eleven-group GitHub CI
previous 700-function cat image, four original cat/stack packets including one explicit expanded-capacity control
previous 700-function cat image, ten independent fixed Torch cat metadata recipes
previous merged 700-function cat image, actual complete thirteen-group GitHub CI

controls_required.other_controls: All original Bool/Integral dtype observations, F32 dtype/axis/entry controls and both conversion/output allocation stages remain mandatory. Explicitly superseded refusal results retain their original FAIL records.

current_runtime_profile.reference_policy: Fixed independently produced reference bytes or the exact pinned live Torch CPU interpreter; no native-result-derived expected values.

capabilities.name: tensor-arithmetic
capabilities.scope: Selected CPU F32 pointwise add/subtract/multiply/divide with right-aligned broadcasting; scoped Bool/I64 and mixed-type paths are separate, explicit contracts.

capabilities.name: unary-and-softmax
capabilities.scope: F32 ReLU/neg/sqrt/exp/log/sigmoid/tanh and single-axis softmax/log-softmax in the documented bounded layouts.

capabilities.name: sum-and-mean
capabilities.scope: Existing F32 reductions and command115 sum with None, empty or signed axis tuples and keepdim; Bool/I64 outputs and explicit conversion to F32 are bounded, separately tested paths.

capabilities.name: logical-reductions
capabilities.scope: Commands118 any and119 all accept Bool, I64, F32, existing rank-zero wrapped F64 Scalars and public dense no-grad F64, and return independent detached Bool Tensor/Storage/Version objects. Empty axis tuples mean no reduction; empty reductions use the appropriate logical identity. Public F16/BF16 input remains explicitly refused with complete rollback.

capabilities.name: bool-sum
capabilities.scope: Command115 explicit Bool result accepts the same source types. Its empty axis tuple means all dimensions. Invalid axes are checked before the requires_grad refusal; floating inputs requiring gradients remain refused. Public F16/BF16 input remains explicitly refused with complete rollback.

capabilities.name: matmul
capabilities.scope: Rank1..4 vector/matrix/broadcast-batched F32 products, selected strided/empty inputs and broadcast-reduced first-order reverse gradients; mm remains rank2-only.

capabilities.name: typed-storage-and-views
capabilities.scope: Real byte-wide Bool, eight-byte I64 and four-byte F32 Storage; selected typed construction/read/fill/casts, transpose, as_strided, view and reshape, alias identity and shared Version behavior. Wrapped F64 remains scalar-only.

capabilities.name: first-order-autograd
capabilities.scope: Explicit or implicit F32 seeds, leaf and selected retained gradients, Saved/Version checks, captured mutation history, scoped mixed F32/I64 gradients and original partial-backward behavior; no full forward/higher-order AD.

capabilities.name: linear-and-losses
capabilities.scope: Selected F32 Linear, broadcast mean-squared loss and rank-two probability-target cross entropy; unsupported overloads and options remain outside the profile.

capabilities.name: convolution-and-pooling
capabilities.scope: Bounded NCHW/OIHW conv2d with documented groups/stride/dilation/padding and floor avg/max pool variants; no complete module or backend coverage.

capabilities.name: normalization
capabilities.scope: Last-dimension LayerNorm and selected evaluation BatchNorm with explicit affine/statistics contracts.

capabilities.name: indexing-and-scatter
capabilities.scope: Selected F32 index_select, gather, scatter_add and index_add with signed-I64 index payloads, duplicate accumulation, empty handling and explicit failure contracts.

capabilities.name: cat-and-stack
capabilities.scope: Documented rank1..4 F32 cat and rank0..3-to-rank1..4 stack, repeated-parent VJP, qualified layout selection and skipped rank-one empty cat gradient accumulation.

capabilities.name: tensor-object-lifetime
capabilities.scope: Owned Tensor/Storage/Version/Weak/Saved/Hold objects, revocable public capabilities, ViewInfo roots, gradient aliases, growing pools and source-bound reset/reference equations.

capabilities.name: optimizers-and-training
capabilities.scope: Selected SGD, momentum/Nesterov and owned Adam/AdamW state/update paths with documented gradient-presence behavior and finite training trajectories; full optimizer/scheduler/API parity is open.

capabilities.name: rng-and-distributions
capabilities.scope: Native CPU MT19937 Generators with complete 5056-byte state, selected distributions and documented partial errors. Mandatory Generator131 preserves original24/native11/entry59/dispatch37, real entropy and separate current-object probes; current736 full execution is pending and this does not qualify every distribution or device.

capabilities.name: public-f64-original-paths
capabilities.scope: Bounded public dense no-gradient F64 paths with all original 33 numeric, 12 boundary, 1 entry and 2 allocation recipes retained. This is not complete F64 arithmetic, layout or AD parity.

capabilities.name: half-storage-and-conversion
capabilities.scope: Public F16/BF16 storage, selected same-dtype alias/copy/fill and F32 narrow/widen conversion paths. Complete original Half47 and independent refusal12 are mandatory. Half arithmetic, AD, any/all and explicit Bool sum are not qualified.

Checkpoint/state serialization, compatibility and interrupted/distributed restoration
CUDA/ROCm/MPS/XPU and all device allocation, transfers, streams and kernels
Distributed process groups, collectives, DDP/FSDP/DTensor and failure semantics
PyTorch graph capture, symbolic shapes, compile/export and artifact compatibility
Dataset/dataloader, workers, multiprocessing, sampling and cancellation
All required platforms, packaging, extension/profiling interfaces and final whole-project acceptance
historical_metadata_policy: Superseded profile descriptions and old execution identities are available through Git history and their original immutable evidence. They are not current-image qualification.
